subject: How can i change dynamically xvar and yvar in a gvisscatterchart using selectinput?

messages.author: 9e5b6647683ad4a8
messages.subject: How can i change dynamically xvar and yvar in a gvisscatterchart using selectinput?
parts:
I want to create  a gvisscatterchart in which i can change xvar and yvar using selectinput but gvisscatterchart does not allow me to do so like a gvisbubblechart for example.Any ideas?




ui.r

tabPanel(strong("SCATTER"),uiOutput("SCAYear"),uiOutput("a"),uiOutput("b"),submitButton(text="Ready"),htmlOutput("SCA"))



server.r

my_choices_a <- names(SCA)[!names(SCA)  %in% c("Year","Name","Team")]
my_choices_b <- names(SCA)[!names(SCA)  %in% c("Year","Name","Team")]

output$a <- renderUI({
      selectInput(inputId = "a",label = "CATEGORY",selected="Min",choices = my_choices_a)
      
    })

    output$b <- renderUI({
      selectInput(inputId = "b",label = "CATEGORY",selected="Pts",choices = my_choices_b)
    })

 output$SCAYear <- renderUI({
      selectInput(inputId = "selectSCAYe", label="YEAR",selected="2001",c(unique(as.character(SCA$Year))))
      
    })

output$SCA <- renderGvis({
      gvisScatterChart(subset(SCA,(Year==input$selectSCAYe&xvar==input$a&yvar==input$b)))                   
    })
